acceptance: No production adoption or proof acceptance; must match complete independently verified stage
performance_scope: Performance only; this is not timing side-channel evidence

compiler_policy.cast_lint_reason: Pinned Dafny emits redundant primitive casts. Disable that category explicitly in both Maven and canonical javac; do not rewrite generated sources or discard emitted diagnostics.
compiler_policy.rawtypes_lint_reason: Pinned Dafny emits a raw dafny.Tuple2 return type for compiled reference tuple functions (observed VerifiedPolynomial.BaseCase). Keep compiler output unchanged; disable this category explicitly in Maven and canonical javac, with every other emitted diagnostic still rejected.
compiler_policy.handwritten_lint_scope: Final acceptance separately compiles all handwritten main Java, including retained providers and facades, with original lint. New generated crypto is classified by its exact checked namespace; existing generated packet Java is classified by an exact source pin. Maven default-testCompile retains original lint for tests.
compiler_policy.package_info_reason: Emit documentation-only package-info.class files with javac in every phase. This avoids Maven synthesizing different package metadata outside the canonical compiler and permits exact comparison of every main class without ignoring metadata.
